sources.note: Mboa is 'apparently extinct' (citing Blench 2011); the Jarawan page's bibliography names Strümpell 1910 as the Mboa wordlist and adds 'Mohammadou (1980) contains a wordlist for Mboa, also called Mbɔŋa', summarized in Mohammadou 2002/2020. No phonological information.

sources.note: Comparative wordlist of 29 Adamawa languages; Mboa is column/row 28 'Mboa (östl. Kongola)'.
